title: Roast squash bowl with chickpeas and avocado
intro: Roast squash and crisp chickpeas over greens, with avocado, tomatoes and a lemon dressing.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Cube the squash, toss it in oil and salt, and roast for 25 minutes.
Drain the chickpeas, pat them dry and roast them beside the squash for the last 15 minutes.
Whisk the lemon juice with the olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Build the bowls on the leaves with sliced avocado and halved tomatoes, then pour over the dressing.
